title: Replace SAM header leaves (sam_hdr_tid2name, sam_hdr_name2tid, sam_hdr_str, sam_hdr_line_name, sam_hdr_destroy, sam_hdr_parse) with pure Rust
description: Replace 6 SAM header FFI leaf functions with pure Rust: sam_hdr_tid2name (14 lines, array access), sam_hdr_name2tid (18 lines, hash lookup), sam_hdr_str (6 lines, accessor), sam_hdr_line_name (40 lines, switch lookup), sam_hdr_destroy (24 lines, refcounted cleanup), sam_hdr_parse (12 lines, text parsing). Used in src/bam/mod.rs. Complexity: trivial-easy.
